acceptanceCriteria: A measured dogfood-finish profile per stage at 70+ hunks, with the dominant stage named.
An interrupted finish is resumable by rerunning finish, or the refusal names the exact recovery.
Wall time at the measured fixture is below 600 s, or a retained reason why not.
dogfood-finish emits per-phase timings to its log (folded from V1-1616).
A docs-only lane finish is also measured before/after and runs under 600 s on a loaded host, or the limit is recorded (folded from V1-1616).
body: PR #1076 lane, 2026-10-17, BASE 8cb1f080c, 72 hunks, load 49-52: `make dogfood-finish` ran over 11 min (stopped during the check stage, dogfood-ocm status). `make dogfood-check` then refused dogfood-report-drift, and the repair rebind (`make dogfood-change` with plan env) hit a 590 s timeout. Expected: finish completes in a bounded time on a 72-hunk change, and an interrupted finish resumes or names its recovery. Related: V1-1658 (record-index-failed), V1-1627..1632 throughput audit.
